steps.action: Preflight GET /api/admin/monitor/runs with bearer token before UI interaction
steps.expected: HTTP 200 healthy payload; proceed with UI testing
steps.observed: HTTP/1.1 200 OK returned with monitor payload (preflight-monitor-runs-headers.txt, preflight-monitor-runs-body.json).

steps.action: In Agent Monitor UI, enter launch prompt, set thinking mode to 'always', click Start, wait until run is running, then click Stop Active
steps.expected: Run launches, thinking_mode=always, and cancel path transitions run to terminal canceled
steps.observed: Run run_1773493615533408346 launched via POST /v1/runs (202), reached running in monitor API and /v1/runs/{id}, Stop Active sent POST /api/admin/monitor/runs/control (200), and terminal status became canceled in both monitor API and /v1/runs/{id}.

steps.action: In Agent Monitor UI, enter second launch prompt, set thinking mode to 'on_error', click Start, wait until run is running, then click per-row Stop on that run
steps.expected: Run launches, thinking_mode=on_error, and per-row cancel transitions run to terminal canceled
steps.observed: Run run_1773493641071066058 launched via POST /v1/runs (202), reached running in monitor API and /v1/runs/{id}, row Stop sent POST /api/admin/monitor/runs/control (200), and terminal status became canceled in both monitor API and /v1/runs/{id}.

steps.action: Verify launch/thinking mode behavior remains correct while cancel behavior is validated
steps.expected: Selected thinking mode is preserved on launched runs
steps.observed: run_1773493615533408346 preserved thinking_mode=always; run_1773493641071066058 preserved thinking_mode=on_error (see run-*-running artifacts and VAL-MIG-MON-002-ui-flow-results.json).

evidence.network: Preflight GET /api/admin/monitor/runs -> 200; launch POST /v1/runs -> 202 (run_1773493615533408346 thinking_mode=always, run_1773493641071066058 thinking_mode=on_error); cancel POST /api/admin/monitor/runs/control -> 200 for both paths (react-migration/monitor-rerun6/VAL-MIG-MON-002-network-events.json).

frictions.description: agent-browser CLI could not launch a browser session due missing shared library (libnspr4.so) in daemon-spawned process.
frictions.resolution: Used documented Playwright/LD_LIBRARY_PATH fallback (LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/mojo/.cache/playwright-libs/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu) to execute the same dashboard UI flow and capture required screenshots/network/API evidence.

summary: Validated VAL-MIG-MON-002 rerun6: preflight monitor API healthy, both cancel paths were triggered only after runs reached running, and both targeted runs ended terminally canceled on both monitor API and /v1/runs/{id} while selected thinking modes remained correct.
